My land for sorghum is small, not even a quarter hectare. A full bag of fertilizer from the cooperative is too big and too costly for this plot, and I would rather use manure from my cattle anyway, just as my father did. I have local seed kept from last season, and my family can do all the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
